architecture_policy: F2 fixes learning destinations and permanent spatial architecture only. It does not write characters, causal scene action, mnemonic sound hooks, or polished narrative prose.

journeys.content_focus: natural selection, heritable variation, differential reproductive success, environmental context, selection modes, sexual selection, and artificial selection
journeys.setting_logic: An observatory begins with evidence and population-level change, then moves through controlled displays that make selection depend on heritable variation, environmental pressure, and reproductive success rather than intention or need.

bundles.title: Historical evidence and population-level evolutionary change
Heritable variation and differential reproductive success
Fitness, environmental context, and molecular consequence

journeys.content_focus: gene pools, mutation, drift, bottlenecks, founder effects, gene flow, allele-frequency change, and Hardy-Weinberg null-model reasoning
journeys.setting_logic: A network of connected island populations makes movement, chance sampling, allele-frequency change, and equilibrium assumptions physically distinct before quantitative practice is deferred to Challenge Lab.

bundles.title: Population, gene pool, and allele-frequency change
Bottleneck, founder effect, and gene flow

journeys.content_focus: fossils, homology, molecular evidence, common ancestry, continuing evolution, resistance, pathogen change, and genetic diversity
journeys.setting_logic: A museum route moves from converging evidence streams to fossil time, morphology, molecular evidence, conserved eukaryotic features, contemporary evolution, and population resilience.

journeys.content_focus: phylogenetic hypotheses, tree anatomy, shared derived characters, outgroups, molecular evidence, grouping, and parsimony
journeys.setting_logic: A navigation archive treats a phylogeny as a revisable map: learners identify what nodes and branches mean, map characters, use an outgroup, and distinguish evidence from inference without turning living taxa into ancestors of one another.

journeys.content_focus: species boundaries, allopatric and sympatric speciation, reproductive barriers, evolutionary tempo, divergence, radiation, convergence, and extinction
journeys.setting_logic: An archipelago turns loss of gene flow into physical barriers and later reproductive barriers, then widens to evolutionary tempo and diversification without implying divergence automatically produces speciation.

journeys.content_focus: early-Earth timing, prebiotic chemistry, historical atmosphere models, Miller-Urey evidence, RNA-world requirements, and the separation of life's origin from later endosymbiosis
journeys.setting_logic: A geochemistry lab proceeds from timeline constraints to plausible chemistry, historical experiments, and RNA-based hypotheses while explicitly separating small-organic-molecule synthesis from the origin of cells and later endosymbiosis.

challenge_lab.canonical_label: Allele frequencies from genotype counts practice

scope_guards.canonical_label: No teleological natural selection
scope_guards.canonical_statement: Do not describe natural selection as knowing what organisms need, trying to improve species, or producing traits for a future purpose.

scope_guards.canonical_label: No strongest-equals-fittest shortcut
scope_guards.canonical_statement: Do not define evolutionary fitness as strength, health, speed, or survival alone; fitness is reproductive success in a particular environment.

scope_guards.canonical_label: No individual-evolution claim
scope_guards.canonical_statement: Do not say that an individual organism evolves genetically during its lifetime; evolutionary genetic change is tracked across generations in populations.

scope_guards.canonical_label: Natural selection is not a random mechanism
scope_guards.canonical_statement: Do not group natural selection itself with random evolutionary change. Selection is systematic differential reproductive success acting on heritable variation.

scope_guards.canonical_label: Generation time is not mutation probability
scope_guards.canonical_statement: Do not infer that prokaryotes have universally higher per-replication mutation rates merely because their generation times are short.

scope_guards.canonical_label: Mutation effects are context dependent
scope_guards.canonical_statement: Do not memorize a fixed universal percentage of mutations as beneficial, neutral, or harmful; effects vary with genomic and environmental context.

scope_guards.canonical_label: Nonrandom mating does not automatically change allele frequencies
scope_guards.canonical_statement: Nonrandom mating can alter genotype frequencies without changing allele frequencies when mating differences are not tied to differential reproductive success.

scope_guards.canonical_label: p and q do not encode dominance
scope_guards.canonical_statement: Never define p as dominant and q as recessive as a general rule; the symbols simply label allele frequencies.

scope_guards.canonical_label: No square-root shortcut from arbitrary observed genotypes
scope_guards.canonical_statement: Do not obtain allele frequencies by square-rooting observed homozygote frequencies unless Hardy-Weinberg genotype proportions are warranted.

scope_guards.canonical_label: Carbon-14 is not for all fossils
scope_guards.canonical_statement: Do not use carbon-14 as a universal fossil-dating method; isotope choice depends on timescale and geologic context.

scope_guards.canonical_label: Vestigial does not mean functionless
scope_guards.canonical_statement: Do not define vestigial structures as necessarily useless. They are remnants of ancestral structures and may retain reduced or modified functions.

scope_guards.canonical_label: Human appendix and coccyx are not functionless examples
scope_guards.canonical_statement: Do not teach the human appendix or coccyx as having no function; both retain biological roles despite being evolutionary remnants of structures with different ancestral functions.

scope_guards.canonical_label: Bird and bat forelimbs remain homologous
scope_guards.canonical_statement: Do not use wing analogy to erase homologous tetrapod forelimb ancestry; flight evolved independently while forelimb skeletal elements share common ancestry.

scope_guards.canonical_label: Early-branching does not mean primitive
scope_guards.canonical_statement: Do not label an extant early-branching lineage as primitive, less evolved, or the direct ancestor of other living taxa.

scope_guards.canonical_label: Paraphyletic and polyphyletic labels are enrichment
scope_guards.canonical_statement: Exact recall of paraphyletic and polyphyletic group terminology is teacher enrichment, not explicit current Unit 7 CED required content.

scope_guards.canonical_label: Parsimony is not the only phylogenetic method
scope_guards.canonical_statement: Do not imply the tree with the fewest changes is always correct; parsimony is one inference approach and phylogenies remain hypotheses subject to new evidence.

scope_guards.canonical_label: Biological species concept has limits
scope_guards.canonical_statement: Do not apply the interbreeding definition uncritically to asexual organisms, fossils, or geographically isolated populations for which reproductive compatibility cannot be directly tested.

scope_guards.canonical_label: Sympatric speciation is not only niche exploitation
scope_guards.canonical_statement: Do not reduce sympatric speciation to exploitation of a new niche; several mechanisms can reduce gene flow without geographic isolation.

scope_guards.canonical_label: Hybrid sterility is not only chromosome-number mismatch
scope_guards.canonical_statement: Do not explain all reduced hybrid fertility solely by different parental chromosome counts; other chromosomal and genic incompatibilities can disrupt fertility.

scope_guards.canonical_label: Divergence does not guarantee speciation
scope_guards.canonical_statement: Do not state that divergent evolution automatically produces a new species; speciation additionally requires reproductive isolation.

scope_guards.canonical_label: Five mass extinctions is not a Unit 7 memorization target
scope_guards.canonical_statement: The classroom reference to five mass extinctions is useful context, but exact memorization of that count is not a current Unit 7 CED requirement.

scope_guards.canonical_label: Do not identify all earliest fossil evidence as cyanobacteria
scope_guards.canonical_statement: Use the CED date range for earliest life evidence without requiring the claim that the oldest evidence is definitively cyanobacterial.

scope_guards.canonical_label: Early Earth did not have abundant free oxygen
scope_guards.canonical_statement: Do not teach abundant oxygen as a driver of prebiotic organic synthesis; free oxygen was scarce on early Earth.

scope_guards.canonical_label: Miller-Urey did not create life or macromolecules
scope_guards.canonical_statement: Do not claim the Miller-Urey experiment produced life, cells, proteins, or nucleic acids; it demonstrated abiotic formation of small organic molecules under simulated conditions.

scope_guards.canonical_label: Endosymbiosis is not the origin of first life
scope_guards.canonical_statement: Do not use endosymbiotic theory as a model for the initial origin of life; it explains later origins of mitochondria and chloroplasts in eukaryotic evolution.
